scene_description: A classroom scene showing a smiling female teacher standing in front of a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. Several children are seated at desks with their hands raised in the air.

questions.question: Who is standing in front of the chalkboard?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the grown-up standing at the front of the room near the green board.

questions.question: What are the children doing with their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's arms and hands in the picture.

questions.question: Where is the teacher standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right behind the teacher.

questions.question: What is the chalkboard used for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is written on the green board behind the teacher.

questions.question: What might the teacher do next when she sees all the hands up?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's raised hands and think about what teachers do when hands go up.

optional_extension_questions.question: Do you ever raise your hand at school or at home?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you wanted to answer a question or get someone's attention.
